name: aavegotchi-envio-indexers
description: Self-hosted Aavegotchi Core + Gotchiverse indexers (Envio + Docker + RunOnFlux)

scripts.codegen:core: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/core-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:gv: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/gotchiverse-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:svg: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/svg-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:portal: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/portal-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:alchemica: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/alchemica-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:staking: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/gltr-staking-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:gbm: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/gbm-baazaar-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:cartridge: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/aarcade-cartridge-base && npm run codegen
scripts.codegen:monolith: bash scripts/ensure-pnpm.sh && cd packages/aavegotchi-monolith-base && npm run codegen
scripts.build:monolith: cd packages/aavegotchi-monolith-base/generated && npm run build && cd .. && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:gv && npm run build:proxy
scripts.build:monolith:all: npm run build:monolith && npm run build:proxy
scripts.docker:core:fresh: bash scripts/docker-core-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-core-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:svg:fresh: bash scripts/docker-svg-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-svg-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:portal:fresh: bash scripts/docker-portal-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-portal-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:alchemica:fresh: bash scripts/docker-alchemica-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-alchemica-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:staking:fresh: bash scripts/docker-staking-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-staking-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:gbm:fresh: bash scripts/docker-gbm-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-gbm-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:cartridge:fresh: bash scripts/docker-cartridge-up.sh down -v && bash scripts/docker-cartridge-up.sh up --build -d
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker/core-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/gotchiverse-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/svg-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/portal-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/alchemica-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/gltr-staking-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/gbm-baazaar-base/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/graphql-proxy/docker-compose.yaml down
